<h3 style="text-align: center;">Practical info</h3>
<p></div></div>

			<p style="text-align: center;">You can use the campground’s shared barbecue and are welcome to bring your own, too. Duvets, pillows and tableware are available in the cabins, but you need to bring your own linen, towels, dish towels/dishcloths and personal necessities. You can also rent bed linens and towels from us to save space in your trunk.</p>
